description: Two openings, one sound. (A) Brain produces a $290 seasonal-site rate workbook for RV park and campground managers: the state campground association lists 640 member parks with published manager emails (counted reachable buyers for this seller), and a pilot send of this offer to 400 of them returned 22 paid orders (5.5%). 640 × 5.5% ≈ 35 orders × $290 ≈ $10,150, so the 11 orders $3,000 needs ($3,190) sit well inside it; $6 cost, card payment at checkout, 3 days to cash. Calendar: sends days 1–10, orders settle by day 13 at the latest, inside 30 days. Brain performs, so owner time is ~0. (B) The owner's on-site host coaching: five signed at $600 = $3,000 exactly, but 8 owner hours a deal = 40 hours against 2 h/week × 30/7 ≈ 8.6 hours allowed. A correct plan uses A and never B.
objective: Collect $3,000 of settled cash within 30 days using no up-front capital and no more than 2 hours a week of my time.

description: A forfeiture-deadline tracker for bail bond agencies. Buyers are counted (410 licensed agencies on the state insurance department list, with phones and emails), a pilot measured 18 paid orders from 300 contacts, Brain produces it at $5 and cash settles in 3 days. At $350, 8 orders ($2,800) would cover $2,500 and 410 × 6% ≈ 24 orders exist. But the $350 is only the owner's word: the pilot invoices were not filed and no source states what any agency paid. Every other link is evidenced; the decisive gap is the price.
objective: Collect $2,500 of settled cash within 30 days using no up-front capital.

description: A small excavation contractor signed a purchase agreement at $38,500 for an off-rent compact track loader that a rental fleet sells for $31,000 plus $900 haulage ($31,900 cost, $6,600 kept). The unit must be bought before the buyer pays, so $31,900 is tied up. First reading: the owner allows $5,000 of capital — the only opening needs $31,900, so infeasible on capital. Then the owner raises starting capital to $35,000: buy day 1, haul by day 5, buyer wires on delivery, cash by day 12 inside 30 days; $38,500 ≥ $5,000 with $31,900 ≤ $35,000 tied up. Executable.
objective: Collect $5,000 of settled cash within 30 days with at most $5,000 of capital.
